title: feat(plugin-approvals): an approver's agent decides a pending approval request over MCP

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DM52bS4K7dyTMDBvMykgUJu)_

domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cxnQXys268N88ne5Ao

Refs #32442 (decide half)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:审批请求上的四个审批人动作(同意、驳回、转签、退回修改)现在对 AI 开放,并且都要求人先确认。审批人在 Claude 等 MCP 客户端里说「同意张三的请假」,agent 先问他确认,带上确认再调用,审批就记在审批人名下、流程继续往下走。
- **为什么改**:你对 #32442 裁了 A:审批人通过 MCP 看待办并处理。本 PR 做「处理」这一半;「看待办」这一半你已裁 A,要先加一个 spec 开关(#32865),之后单独做,所以本 PR 只写 `Refs`,不关卡。
- **风险与回滚**:谁能拍板没有变,门禁仍是审批服务本身,和控制台按钮完全一样:当前审批人;同意、驳回、转签三项另外允许可以接管卡住请求的管理员。所以管理员的 agent 也能像管理员点按钮一样接管,同样要先确认。陌生人、提交人、AI 服务账号都会被拒,请求保持待审批。回滚即撤本 PR。
- **先看**:① `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.ts` 的四个 `ai` 块和动作数组上方的说明;② `packages/qa/dogfood/test/approval-decide-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts`(真实启动,走 MCP 实测五种调用者)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/approval-decide-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts`,预期 5 条全过:审批人看到四个动作;陌生人、提交人、AI 服务账号被拒;审批人未确认被拒 428,确认后请求变为 approved。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`sys_approval_request` (`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.ts`).** The four approver decisions, `approval_approve`, `approval_reject`, `approval_reassign` and `approval_send_back`, declare `ai: { exposed: true, description, requiresConfirmation: true }`. `approval_reassign` also carries a `paramHints.to` saying `to` is the new approver's user id. Every other action on the object (remind, recall, resubmit, request-info, comment) stays off the AI surface: the ruling named the four decisions.
- **Who may decide is not declared here.** Each of the four is a same-origin `type: 'api'` action, so MCP `run_action` forwards it to its approvals route (`/api/v1/approvals/requests/{id}/approve|reject|reassign|revise`) as the caller (ADR-0066 D4 note of 2026-10-30), and `ApprovalService` admits exactly whom the console's buttons admit. Nothing in `packages/mcp` or `packages/runtime` changes: the `sys_*` per-action opt-in (#27681, ruling 6513869839) already admits an action that declares `ai.exposed`.
- **Confirmation.** ADR-0011's 2026-10-30 addendum bucket C ("exposed, confirmed": a consequential, bounded act). Precedent: `sys_user.ban_user`, `sys_user.set_manager` (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`). `run_action` refuses `428 ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` until the call carries `confirm: true`.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx` gains one bullet beside the identity-actions bullet: which approval actions an agent sees, the confirmation, who the service admits.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/32442-approval-decisions-ai-exposure.md`, `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` patch.

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.test.ts`, new block "sys_approval_request AI exposure (#32442)": exactly the four decisions are exposed; each asks for confirmation and carries a tool description of its own (40+ characters, names "current approver"); each targets its own same-origin decision route; `to` is hinted as a user id. The #7278 pin "the confirm question is human dialog copy, never armed as an AI tool description" asserted `approval_reject.ai.description` was undefined; it now asserts the dialog question (the top-level `description`) is not in the tool description, which is the pin's intent once reject is exposed.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/approval-decide-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts` (new): real `SecurityPlugin`, flows, approvals and MCP plugins; a one-step flow waiting on one approver by email. Each pin gets its own request, over the live `/api/v1/mcp` transport:
  1. the approver's `list_actions` lists the four decisions on `sys_approval_request`, attested `aiExposed`, `requiresConfirmation: true`;
  2. a member on no slate, confirmed: `REQUEST_NOT_FOUND` (the service's existence non-disclosure), request pending, no decision row;
  3. the submitter, confirmed: `FORBIDDEN` "is not a pending approver", request pending, no decision row;
  4. an AI service account acting for itself (ADR-0151; registered by the admin, its own API key, on no slate), confirmed: `REQUEST_NOT_FOUND`, request pending, no decision row;
  5. the approver unconfirmed: `ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`, nothing recorded; confirmed: request `approved`, one `approve` row whose `actor_id` is the approver.
- **Ablations** (each on the committed head, restored by an EXIT trap; the dogfood config aliases `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` to source):

| Ablation | Diff | Result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1: `decideNode` admits anyone (the `refuseUnreadableRequest` call removed, the slot-holder check short-circuited) | `approval-service.ts` +1 −2 | pins 2, 3, 4 red; 1, 5 green |
| A2: `approval_approve` without `requiresConfirmation` | object file −1 | pins 1, 5 red |
| A3: `approval_approve` with `exposed: false` | object file ±1 | all 5 red |

## Acceptance notes

- **The read half is not here.** Step 0 on `main` `2fc3fce5`: every MCP object tool refuses every `sys_*` object by name (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`, the `guard` in `registerObjectTools` and the `list_objects` filter), with no per-object opt-in, so an approver cannot list their pending requests over MCP. The maintainer ruled A on that half (6837430865); its spec key is #32865, and the read half is blocked by it. Until then an agent decides a request whose id it has (the approval notification's link carries it).
- **The override holder.** `ApprovalService.decideNode` (approve, reject) and `reassign` admit a current approver or the override holder (#3424, `isOverrideActor`); `sendBack` admits a current approver only. The console's `visible` predicates say the same (approve, reject and reassign OR in `can_override`, send back does not). An administrator's agent can therefore override-decide, behind the same confirmation; the decision is recorded `via_override` as today. Seat 5 kept this as the console has it.
- **An AI service account named on a slate.** Pin 4 covers an account on no slate. An account an approval step names is refused by ADR-0151 D3 rule 3 once #32691 lands: all four declare `requiresConfirmation: true`, which that PR refuses for an account whatever the request carries.
- **No second gate.** Nothing in this diff checks who the caller is; the negative pins are the approval service's answers seen through MCP, and A1 shows them turn red when that gate is removed.

## Verification

They ran after a whole-tree `pnpm build` ("BUILD_EXIT 0", 11m14s), with `pnpm lint` and the two packages' typechecks appended. The full pass started on `d4fe7020c7`; the commits after it change only prose (the docs bullet, the changeset, a code comment, and the four `ai.description` strings), so the 37 commands whose inputs that prose reaches (docs, changeset, i18n, citation, wording gates, the plugin's typecheck, eslint on the three code files) were re-run on the final head `62de438433`: all exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood run typecheck` hit a local V8 heap limit (exit 134, out of memory, no TS diagnostic); re-run with `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`: exit 0, 0 `error TS`.

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran FILE`: "95 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 95 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED", exit 0.
